tool.name: Praat
tool.command:
mkdir -p "\$PWD/praat_workspace/inputs" "\$PWD/praat_workspace/outputs" && ln -s "\$PWD/praat_workspace" /workspace &&
## Tell the container's startup script where to find the Praat workspace. export PRAAT_WORKDIR=/workspace &&
#from os.path import splitext #from re import sub #if str($audio_file.ext) != 'wav' echo "ERROR: The audio file must be WAV format." >&2 exit 1 #end if #if str($transcript_file.ext) not in ['txt', 'textgrid'] echo "ERROR: The transcript file must be TXT or TextGrid format." >&2 exit 1 #end if #set $audio_stem = sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+', '_', splitext(str($audio_file.name))[0]).strip('._') or 'sanitized_name_empty' #set $audio_filename = "input_audio_%s_galaxy_hid_%s.%s" % ($audio_stem, $audio_file.hid, $audio_file.ext) #set $transcript_stem = sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+', '_', splitext(str($transcript_file.name))[0]).strip('._') or 'sanitized_name_empty' #set $transcript_filename = "input_transcript_%s_galaxy_hid_%s.%s" % ($transcript_stem, $transcript_file.hid, $transcript_file.ext)
printf 'Copying Galaxy audio file into inputs directory as %s\n' '${audio_filename}'; cp '$audio_file' "\$PRAAT_WORKDIR/inputs/${audio_filename}"; printf 'Copying Galaxy transcript file into inputs directory as %s\n' '${transcript_filename}'; cp '$transcript_file' "\$PRAAT_WORKDIR/inputs/${transcript_filename}";
## Make only the outputs directory writable by Praat. chown --reference="\$PWD" "\$PRAAT_WORKDIR/outputs" && /init

param.name: transcript_file
param.label: Transcript File
param.help: A single .lab or .TextGrid file with the transcript for the audio.

tool.help:
Praat provides interactive speech analysis, visualization, and annotation.
Launch this tool and open the desktop from Active Interactive Tools. Selected files are copied into the inputs directory and opened automatically. Your original Galaxy datasets are not modified.
Ensure you save the results in the outputs directory, then close Praat via Praat -> Quit Praat in Praat before clicking on the red square under Praat in the Interactive Tools panel.The container finishes and Galaxy collects the saved files into a collection. Closing the browser tab leaves the desktop running.
Browser audio is enabled in the image. If playback is silent, enable audio in the web interface and select PulseAudio under Praat's Sound playing preferences. Browser microphone recording is not provided by this setup.
The Praat Galaxy interactivetool currently accepts one .wav file and one .txt or .TextGrid file as inputs. Output is also limited to .TextGrid files. It is also not yet possible to run Praat scripts in the interactive tool. The only permissible output is currently .TextGrid; praat.collections is not supported.
